## Pre-fire identity gate (run on the firing seat; paste output here BEFORE firing)

```bash
CANDIDATE_SHA=<FINAL_CANDIDATE_SHA>

# G1 exact 40-char lowercase hex, never trimmed

  --jq '.content' | base64 -d | grep -c '<FEATURE_MARKER>'   # want > 0
```

mechanical_corrections.title: Resolve <FINAL_CANDIDATE_SHA> exactly once, mechanically
mechanical_corrections.rationale: plan.candidate_sha is null. The token appears 310 times across the 38 bodies and 38 more times in artifact_subtree (348 sites). It is a single unambiguous literal with no partial-word collisions, so substitution is safe and verifiable. evidence-writer.mjs rejects any non-40-char lowercase SHA, and validate-corpus requires capture_sha == directory name.
mechanical_corrections.procedure: 1. Freeze the candidate. 2. Assert `[[ "$SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]`. 3. Set `plan.candidate_sha`. 4. `python3 -c` byte substitution of the literal `<FINAL_CANDIDATE_SHA>` -> `$SHA` over `rows[].body`, `rows[].title` and `rows[].artifact_subtree`. 5. Assert zero residual occurrences of `<FINAL_CANDIDATE_SHA>` and exactly 348 occurrences of `$SHA`. 6. Leave `<SEAT>`, `<SESSION_KEY>`, `<EXACT_CANDIDATE_WORKTREE>`, `<EMPTY_PRIVATE_ARTIFACT_DIR>`, `<FEATURE_SOURCE_PATH>`, `<FEATURE_MARKER>` unsubstituted - those are per-seat runtime values.
